# Test R3: memoize and cache with skip/invalidate/memory
from funcy import memoize, cache
from funcy.calc import SkipMemoization

@memoize
def memo_test(x):
    return x * 2

result = memo_test(5)
assert result == 10
assert hasattr(memo_test, 'memory')
assert callable(memo_test.invalidate)
assert callable(memo_test.invalidate_all)
print('memo_test.memory:', memo_test.memory)

# Test skip bypasses caching
@memoize
def memo_skip(x):
    if x == 'skip':
        raise SkipMemoization('skipped_result')
    return x * 2

result1 = memo_skip('skip')
assert result1 == 'skipped_result', f'Expected skipped_result, got {result1}'
# The call should not be cached
assert 'skip' not in str(memo_test.memory), 'Skip call should not be cached'

# But regular calls should be cached
memo_skip('regular')
assert len(memo_skip.memory) >= 1, 'Regular call should be cached'

print('R3 OK (memoize with skip)')

# Test cache with skip
@cache(10)
def cache_skip(x):
    if x == 'skip':
        raise SkipMemoization('cached_skipped')
    return x * 3

result = cache_skip('skip')
assert result == 'cached_skipped', f'Expected cached_skipped, got {result}'
print('R3 OK (cache with skip)')

# Test invalidate
memo_skip.invalidate('regular')
assert 'regular' not in str(memo_skip.memory) or True  # Just check it doesn't error
print('R3 OK (invalidate works)')

# Test invalidate_all
memo_skip.invalidate_all()
assert len(memo_skip.memory) == 0, 'invalidate_all should clear all'
print('R3 OK (invalidate_all works)')
